claims.explanation: Teniposide is a topoisomerase II poison that stabilizes TOP2A/DNA cleavage complexes, so sensitivity is driven primarily by TOP2A expression and proliferative rate rather than by any single driver mutation. The most consistent genomic correlate in the observed lines is that sensitive lines carry TP53 pathway disruption combined with high TOP2A/proliferation, while resistant lines tend to have low TOP2A, low proliferation, or efflux/BCL2-mediated survival. Features such as TOP2A expression, TOP2B expression, and TP53 mutation are therefore the strongest predictors, with MRP3/ABCB1 efflux and BCL2/BCL2L1 antiapoptotic expression as protective.

features.basis: Teniposide poisons TOP2A; higher target enzyme levels increase cleavage-complex formation and cytotoxicity (PMID 6094001, 2557897)
Teniposide also inhibits TOP2B, so expression of either topoisomerase II isoform can mediate drug-induced DNA damage (PMID 2557897)
Damaging TP53 mutations are enriched in the most-killed lines and impair DNA-damage-induced arrest/repair, favoring mitotic catastrophe after topoisomerase II poisoning
P-glycoprotein efflux reduces intracellular epipodophyllotoxin and confers resistance to teniposide
MRP3 transports epipodophyllotoxins and confers low-level resistance to teniposide (PMID 10359813)
Antiapoptotic BCL2 blocks the mitochondrial apoptosis that follows teniposide-induced DNA damage
BCL-xL overexpression similarly blunts apoptosis downstream of topoisomerase II poisoning
DNA-damage-induced FasL expression via NF-kB/AP-1 contributes to teniposide-induced apoptosis in lymphoid cells (PMID 9660938)
NF-kB activation is required for FasL induction and apoptosis after teniposide treatment (PMID 9660938)
AP-1 (Fos/Jun) activation cooperates with NF-kB to drive FasL expression and teniposide-induced apoptosis (PMID 9660938)
Proliferation rate determines TOP2A levels and the fraction of cells in S/G2, the phases most vulnerable to topoisomerase II poisons
Loss of p16/CDKN2A releases G1/S restraint and increases the proliferating, TOP2A-high fraction that teniposide kills
